answer: Agents register enclave-generated keys through zero-knowledge TPM/SGX attestation; willow is the append-only identity state tree, yarrow anchors its roots, and marble is the consensus contract that accepts only fresh measurements. Forging N identities requires physically provisioning or compromising N distinct enclaves and defeating their signed measurements; marble enforces an O(N^2) bonding curve and irreversibly slashes collateral on duplicate or equivocal attestations.
